items.title: How to Transform an Enterprise That Already Works - with Alexandra Guenther of Leidos
items.summary: The hardest enterprises to transform are often the ones already succeeding, where there's no burning platform to justify change. In this episode, Alexandra Guenther, SVP and Chief Information Officer at Leidos, explores how leaders find the negative space between current performance and future opportunity, and build a case for change using concrete value levers like revenue, margin, risk, and employee capacity. She also discusses how to surface grassroots innovation already happening inside the organization, manage the psychological resistance that accompanies change, and reframe agentic AI development around clearly defining what the technology should not do. ​ Enterprise AI buyers want to know where your solution fits and what value it can deliver.
